outcome: Disease activity (measured using C-reactive protein, fecal calprotectin, Harvey-Bradshaw Index, or partial Mayo scores)
cohort: 48 pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease.
finding: Several urine and serum metabolites were altered by active IBD throughout pregnancy, and some of these metabolites were predictive of disease activity and correlated with mode of delivery and infant birth weight.
mod_finding: Serum metabolites (TMAO, glucose, and acetic acid) predicted first trimester disease activity and correlated with mode of delivery and infant weights at delivery.
